supersession_reason: Phase 3 hull expansion: adds three neurodegen-cohort HC arms — AddNeuroMed n=96 (HM450), AIBL n=471 (EPIC — FIRST CROSS-PLATFORM REPRESENTATION), GIFT n=193 (HM450). Expands hull to include AD-eligible-elderly HC and FTD-eligible-elderly HC populations, and introduces EPIC platform variance via AIBL. Total: 2,481 HC across 7 cohorts.

GSE153712 AIBL HC n=471 (EPIC 850K — FIRST CROSS-PLATFORM, AD-cohort HC)
GSE53740 GIFT HC n=193 (HM450, FTD-cohort HC)
